notes: DG3 is an engineering delivery gate only. It grants no real business, Finance or IT approval and implies nothing about product gates G1-G6. Product gate G4 decisions in the evidence are synthetic demo decisions by synthetic dev users. All 5 DG3 findings (F-DG3-100, 120, 170, 180, 280) are CLOSED_VERIFIED by non-owners, and there are no DG3 accepted observations. The F-DG3-100 closure (round 6, re-confirmed in round 7) is sound: ADR-0024 §6 claims only enumerated, checked behaviour, and states its residual honestly (unexercised paths; self-handling forms outside L1-L7). The D-082 and D-084 incidents were handled acceptably: no closure or verdict relies on the tainted round-2 runs, and no run after the round-3 freeze reports a configuration change. Non-finding observations: (1) for delivery-orchestrator: D-083 says both KBE-E and FE-G report external_config_changed, but only FE-G's meta does. The ARCH-02 implementer run (before any review) reports 39 'removed' entries under /home/user/wt/dg3-kbe-a, which no decision mentions. Correct both in the next decision. (2) For backend-workflow-engineer and frontend-ux-engineer, carried to DG6 (REQ-S15-007): the D-079 limitation, where a G4 capacity-conflict item can show a role's English labelEn in Arabic, is acceptable as disclosed for DG3. (3) For frontend-ux-engineer, carried to DG6 (REQ-S15-009): the pre-existing gate grid scrolls horizontally at 390 px with 200% root text (qa F180b; the badge stays inside its card). (4) The session-identity.test.tsx flake under load (D-083/D-084) is acceptable as disclosed; it did not recur in round 7.
